claims.text: Large language models represent a new paradigm for processing unstructured data across a wide range of domains.
Large language models are inherently statistical models due to their data dependency and stochastic generation processes.
Statistical insights are essential for handling variability and uncertainty in large language models.
The persistent black-box nature of large language models renders closed-form or purely mechanistic analyses generally intractable.
Intractability in analyzing large language models necessitates statistical approaches due to their flexibility and effectiveness.
Statistical methodologies are critically needed in research areas including alignment, watermarking, uncertainty quantification, evaluation, and data mixture optimization.
Statistical research concerning large language models will likely form a diverse mosaic of specialized topics rather than deriving from a single unifying theory.

evidence.description: Large language models (LLMs) represent a new paradigm for processing unstructured data, with applications across an unprecedented range of domains.
LLMs are inherently statistical models due to their profound data dependency and stochastic generation processes...
...where statistical insights are naturally essential for handling variability and uncertainty.

...the persistent black-box nature of LLMs—stemming from their immense scale, architectural complexity, and development practices often prioritizing empirical performance over theoretical interpretability—renders closed-form or purely mechanistic analyses generally intractable...
...thereby necessitating statistical approaches due to their flexibility and often demonstrated effectiveness.

...outlines several research areas—including alignment, watermarking, uncertainty quantification, evaluation, and data mixture optimization—where statistical methodologies are critically needed and are already beginning to make valuable contributions.
We conclude with a discussion suggesting that statistical research concerning LLMs will likely form a diverse “mosaic” of specialized topics, rather than deriving from a single unifying theory...

limitations.text: Closed-form or purely mechanistic analyses of LLMs are generally intractable due to immense scale, architectural complexity, and black-box nature.

future_work.text: Developing statistical methodologies across a diverse mosaic of specialized topics concerning LLMs, including alignment, watermarking, uncertainty quantification, evaluation, and data mixture optimization.
Timely engagement by the statistics community in LLM research.
